confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for July 2026 from general knowledge; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Meal and coffee anchors are moderately grounded, while hotel and hostel rates are seasonal and less certain. Beer is a bounded estimate because licensed-venue pricing varies. Cocktail and wine glass were derived from the beer anchor because direct knowledge of Marrakech bar prices is weak: cocktail is set at roughly 1.7 times beer and wine glass at roughly 1.25 times beer. FX came from a search result citing the RBA exchange-rates page; the page itself was not separately read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other Moroccan medina tourist cities such as Fez, with accommodation adjusted upward for Marrakech's stronger tourism demand; no specific comparable-city dataset was retrieved.
